negative_controls: The same44100 in stored metadata and fallback is explicitly non-discriminating.
A segment Stream outside the cluster file list is unsupported by the proposed bounded parser, even though archive mechanics can represent it.
Distinct File FNPath and descriptor FNPath must remain distinct relationships; no nearest-name or filesystem search substitutes.
Raw REA slices omit global data, imports, type information and exception context. Native original-image instructions and separately pinned literals/vtable bytes are authoritative.
Metadata intervals are not proof of bodies. Ghidra may omit exception tails or report external branches as bad instruction; verification retains those differences.
C-like pseudocode is not compilable or bit-faithful recovered source.
